subject: Exec sponsor ownership + MAP delivery — locking EB slot & close runway
messages:

To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@acme.com>
Cc: Jared Lee <jared.lee@acme.com>
Date: 2027-03-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec sponsor ownership + MAP draft for review

Hi Alice — thanks again for the time today. Per our discussion I put together an updated mutual action plan that reflects: 1) the evaluation milestones Acme needs for the CTO review, 2) procurement's preferred legal/PO gating, and 3) a proposed EB (executive briefing) where we present ROI evidence and close criteria.

Quick summary of the short MAP timeline:
- Week 1 (Mar 15–19): Security questionnaire + SOC artifacts delivered to Acme legal
- Week 2 (Mar 22–26): Engineering trial (two-week sandbox) + success criteria checklist
- Week 3 (Mar 29–Apr 2): Exec briefing and cost/terms negotiation

Request: can you confirm who on Acme's side will be the executive sponsor for the EB? Jared indicated he can chair if needed, but if you prefer the CFO or VP Product we can adjust the narrative.

Attached is the MAP v3 with estimated decision checkpoints. I’ll follow up with internal owners on our side to map sponsor handoffs and lock an EB date.

Attachments: [ACME_MAP_v3.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Thanks —
Ben Carter

From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme.com; Jared Lee <jared.lee@acme.com>
Date: 2027-03-10T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec sponsor ownership + MAP draft for review

Thanks Ben — received and went through the MAP. A few notes:
- Procurement looped in (procurement@acme.com) to start standard terms review. They prefer a short checklist of must-haves vs nice-to-haves.
- For the EB, Jared is open to chairing technical content, but our CFO (Lena Park) wants to be the financial sponsor — she will attend but likely won’t host.
- Can you shorten the EB to a 45-minute slot (30 min presentation + 15 min Q&A)? Our exec calendar is tight.

Would also appreciate a succinct one-pager that outlines: decision ask, risks mitigations, and the expected first-quarter savings — Lena reads those before calendar commitments.

I can confirm attendees by EOD Monday once I have procurement and legal availability.

Best,
Alice
Director, Strategic Partnerships — Acme Corp
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-10T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: ACME MAP owners + EB prep (need one-pager + finance slide)

Team — forwarding Alice's note. Requesting quick alignment so we can lock the EB window next week. Key asks:
1) Owner assignments (who drafts the one-pager for Lena)
2) Who will lead the EB narrative for finance vs technical (Marissa to lead finance? Karthik to lead technical?)
3) Availability for execs: proposed EB windows (all times PT):
   - Tue Mar 23 10:00–10:45
   - Wed Mar 24 14:00–14:45
   - Thu Mar 25 08:30–09:15 (early slot)

Proposed sponsor mapping (initial):
- Acme exec sponsor: Lena Park (CFO) — decision authority on spend
- Acme technical champion: Jared Lee (CTO) — owns evaluation feedback
- Redwood exec sponsor: Marissa Cole (VP Sales) — commercial & exec alignment
- Redwood technical owner: Karthik Iyer (Solutions Eng) — demo and acceptance criteria

Olga — can you prepare the security artifact bundle and flag any open SOC 2 items we should pre-emptively call out to Acme legal?
Marissa/Karthik — can you each take a draft slide: finance summary (Marissa) and performance acceptance criteria (Karthik)? I’ll consolidate into the one-pager and share back to Alice.

I’m aiming to have the EB invite tentative by end of day Friday so Alice can confirm with their execs. Quick replies appreciated.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-11T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: ACME MAP owners + EB prep (need one-pager + finance slide)

Ben — I can own the finance one-pager and will focus on three things: 1) succinct decision ask, 2) conservative first-quarter savings estimate with assumptions, and 3) recommended commercial terms (billing cadence + proposed short pilot pricing). I’ll keep it to a single slide + one paragraph summary for Lena.

Availability for EB: Wed Mar 24 14:00–14:45 PT works best for our execs. If Alice confirms that slot, I’ll block Marissa/Ben exec calendars and prepare a 10-minute topline ROI deck for Lena.

Karthik — can you confirm the acceptance criteria bullets and whether the sandbox demo will need any special infra (API key scopes, sample data redaction)? If there’s a dependency on our side, list it so Ben can set expectations with Acme engineering.

Olga — please bundle the security artifacts and include a short note on retention and key management options — Acme legal will want that up front.

Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

- Decision ask: approve pilot purchase order + two-month production trial
- Success criteria: latency < 250ms 95th, accuracy benchmarks on seeded prompts, security checklist green
- Commercial ask: pilot pricing + proposed renewal discount window

Attachments: [ACME_MAP_v3.pdf, one-pager_finance_ACME.pdf, security-q_a_responses.docx, EB_invite.ics]

Next steps: Alice to confirm CFO and legal availability by EOD Monday. If they need an earlier slot we can offer Tue Mar 23 10:00–10:45 PT as alternative.

Thanks all — I’ll follow up with the invite + HubSpot update after Alice confirms.
